mentions.name: Meteor
mentions.description: Meteor is an agentic browser that removes the prompting layer from computer-use agents (CUA). It aims to be a browser that understands the user and can take actions on their behalf like a personal assistant.
mentions.problem: Computer-use agents require an explicit prompting layer; the author got tired of waiting for Perplexity to launch Comet, so built their own browser that acts directly.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm building Meteor (https://browse.dev) - an agentic browser.
The goal is to remove the prompting layer in CUA, and to have a browser that just gets you and can do actions like a personal assistant.
